name: Consistencia Dental
algorithm: Teeth Consistency — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method analyzes teeth rendering and consistency for deepfake detection:

1. **Teeth Detección & Segmentation**: When the mouth is open during speech or smiling, visible teeth are detected and segmented. Individual teeth boundaries, alignment, and arrangement are analyzed per frame.

2. **Dental Anatomy Verificación**: The method checks dental anatomy: (a) correct tooth count for visible region, (b) proper tooth shapes (incisors, canines, premolars with distinct morphology), (c) realistic tooth size and spacing, (d) gum line contour. AI generators often produce blurred, merged, or anatomically incorrect teeth — too many, too few, or with impossible shapes.

3. **Teeth Textura & Color**: Real teeth show characteristic features: translucency at the incisal edge, varying color (slightly yellow body, whiter enamel surface), surface texture (microlines, stain patterns). The method evaluates teeth rendering quality. Generated teeth are often unrealistically white, uniformly colored, or lacking surface detail.

4. **Temporal Teeth Estabilidad**: Teeth structure is completely rigid — tooth positions, sizes, and arrangement cannot change between frames. The method tracks teeth geometry frame-to-frame. Changes in visible tooth arrangement (teeth appearing/disappearing, changing shape) indicate AI generation where teeth are rendered independently per frame.

5. **Teeth - Labio Interaction**: During speech, lips interact with teeth in specific ways — upper teeth visible during /f/ and /v/ sounds, teeth edges visible during particular articulations. The method checks teeth-lip coordination. Deepfakes may show teeth visibility that doesn't correlate with the spoken phonemes.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante teeth consistency analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Rossler, A. et al. (2019). FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images. ICCV.
Matern, F. et al. (2019). Exploiting Visual Artifacts to Expose Deepfakes. WACVW.
